beats.copy: When an agent touches a critical system or system of record, ask what the code is allowed to change—not who wrote it.

beats.copy: Review depth follows authority. Low-risk work can move fast; critical changes need a named human who understands intent, risk, and recovery.

beats.copy: AI can propose the change. It cannot own the consequence. Before you ship, ask what this code can change and who owns the result.
